description_excerpt: Job Description We're looking for an enthusiastic and relationship-focused Associate, Driver Acquisition to join our growing team in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. In this role, you will be the face of our driver recruitment efforts, delivering exceptional service and driving acquisition through meaningful interactions with potential drivers. You will be responsible for creating a welcoming experience for prospective drivers, showcasing the benefits of our platform, and helping them understand exactly how they can succeed with us.
